title: InvestigatorEnvelope
description: Pull-shaped evidence brief produced by the investigator subagent. The investigator outputs evidence for the human to prune, NOT a draft contract. Forbidden fields (draft_contract, intent_contract, done_when, scope_in, scope_out, acceptance, objective) are mechanically rejected.

evidence.description: Citable refs supporting the observation. Each item is either a free-form string or an object with file/line/snippet.

duplicate_candidates.description: Possible duplicate observations with similarity reasons.

confidence.description: Investigator's confidence the observation is real.

proposed_tier.description: Suggested tier (advisory, not authoritative — human decides).

grill_question.description: One tight question the human should consider before ratifying.
